weather.summary: Hot and humid conditions are expected throughout Singapore, with afternoon shower risk and very high daytime track temperatures before the night sessions cool the surface.
weather.sourceLabel: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix weekend forecast · Oct 7

commandBrief.label: CHAMPIONSHIP
commandBrief.title: Antonelli arrives with an 84-point lead
commandBrief.text: The championship leader has 320 points to Russell's 236 after Sepang, with Hamilton third on 214.

commandBrief.label: RUSSELL
commandBrief.title: Sprint points come before a Sunday rear-grid start
commandBrief.text: Russell's power-unit penalty applies to the Grand Prix, leaving Saturday's Sprint as his cleanest immediate scoring opportunity.

commandBrief.label: TECHNICAL
commandBrief.title: Mercedes will compare two specifications
commandBrief.text: Russell returns to the Baku-winning aero specification while Antonelli runs the newer package with a new front wing.

latestClassification.message: No Singapore session classification has been published yet. FP1 begins Friday at 16:30 local time.

notes: Singapore is Round 17 and the final Sprint weekend of the 2026 season.
The weekend begins with one practice session before Sprint Qualifying.
Heat-hazard regulations are active for the Sprint and Grand Prix; shower risk remains in the forecast.
